title: Drift Remediation Config
description: Mapping from warn-only pre-commit drift hook ids to canonical remediation commands. Consumed by the docs-reviewer and docs-writer agents. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-04-23-763-drift-hook-integration-design.md for the design.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor tooling.

hooks.description: Map of pre-commit hook id to remediation descriptor. Key MUST match an id: field in .pre-commit-config.yaml.

script.description: Path to the remediation script, relative to repo root. Must be executable.

args.description: Arguments passed to the script when invoked by docs-writer Mode 5.

auto_apply.description: If true, docs-writer Mode 5 invokes the script and stages the resulting diff. If false, Mode 5 emits a proposed-fix note instead. Only opt in for deterministic, idempotent scripts.

description.description: One-line summary of what the remediation does. Shown in findings and triage output.
